decisions.distinctness: Git whole-object header/OID/native zlib boundary from the actual OS codec; earlier cases cover generic native transform concurrency, not a valid loose-object format.
One compound actual Git tree mechanism: directory slash byte ordering plus all five serialized modes; no extra case credit for each mode.
Actual Git ordered parent/custom-header/identity/message serialization and legal header continuation; no RPC numeric/date clone or multipart newline claim.
Actual Git delta instruction interpreter with one compound copy/insert trace; not an array-copy value grid, bounds-negative input, stream, or digest case.

Actual Git pack header/entry/zlib-boundary/OID/body-trailer integration with a complete four-type valid pack. Earlier B stream payloads expressly were not valid Git parsing; earlier digest/backpressure cases lack objects and entry framing.
Distinct actual object-base resolution: backward OFS boundary arithmetic and REF lookup of an already-yielded delta result. Not an extra chunking/digest case.

excluded_scope: Git push authorization or cache authorization paths
External Git service, storage API, or network fixture
counting: One primary candidate per compound mechanism. Primitive reuse, assertion count, modes and chunk slices earn no extra credit.
